title: Turn 10,994 Notes Into Memory - Paul Iusztin, Decoding AI & Louis-François Bouchard, Towards AI
talk_summary: They built an AI Research OS that ingests personal notes, repos, and links into immutable raw files, an index.yaml catalog, and an LLM-generated wiki of summaries, concepts, and comparisons. The core lesson is a file-based, token-efficient retrieval hierarchy plus reusable skills, not a vector database.

takeaways.what_they_do: They keep raw sources immutable, catalog them in index.yaml with summaries and metadata, and have agents read the index, then source summaries, then wiki derivatives, and only then raw files.
takeaways.evidence_quote: the agent will have as input this index.yaml file, which contains summaries and metadata about each source
takeaways.numbers: Example index had 10 sources and 38 wiki pages

takeaways.what_they_do: They separate human/source-of-truth raw files from LLM-generated wiki pages such as concepts, entities, comparisons, notes, and open questions.
takeaways.evidence_quote: every question leaves a trace into your wiki

takeaways.what_they_do: Agents are instructed to stop at the cheapest sufficient layer: index summary, then source executive summary, then wiki derivatives, then full raw source only if needed.
takeaways.evidence_quote: only if it doesn't find the necessary information up to this point, it needs and it actually reads the whole raw source

takeaways.what_they_do: An orchestrator generates bounded query rounds, subagents gather and summarize sources, then a ranking step fully scrapes only top-K high-signal links.
takeaways.numbers: 3 rounds x 6 queries produced 40-50 links; light=1 round x3, fast=2 rounds x3; runs took 10-20 minutes

takeaways.what_they_do: They package research, search, and distillation workflows as Claude Code/Codex skills/plugins that can be invoked by pointing at a file or topic.
takeaways.evidence_quote: it's basically just skills for Cloud Code and Codex with plugins

takeaways.what_they_do: They keep a global immutable second brain and scope it down into a project wiki when starting work, rather than letting the wiki sit on top of all notes.
takeaways.evidence_quote: The project is the work, and your second brain is the research.
